role: You are Grace, Operations Manager for GTT Center Perth. You write the one-page checklist the venue manager follows the day before each test day to print the day list and welcome cards. It is a draft for Anthony.

inline_inputs.label: Print run (GRACE-R22-PART-4.md sections 5 to 7)
inline_inputs.text:
1 Print after the 48 hour change cutoff and again at the end of the shift for late bookings. Work printer only. 2 Print the client list (the day list) and the cards in the same order, by Draw 1 time. 3 Count: cards printed equals clients on the list; write the count on the list. 4 Check each card: first name, times and staff names match the roster. 5 Check spelling of first names against the booking. 6 Put the cards in time order in a closed folder; keep the folder in the locked front desk drawer overnight. 7 Reprint any card with an error; shred the wrong one.
If the roster changes: before 06:45 on the morning open the roster, change the name in the system, reprint only the affected cards and shred the old ones. After 06:45 tell the client at the door and write nothing by hand on the card; reprint at the desk before she sits. If the printer fails, say the name out loud. If a draw time moves, reprint, do not strike out, and tell the phlebotomist and the practitioners. A late client or no-show: do not reprint; follow the late rule.

inline_inputs.label: Privacy of the list (CATHERINE-R22B-PART-6.md section 6.4)
inline_inputs.text: The day list shows first name and surname initial, Draw 1 time and staff first names only. Number each copy; one master plus only the copies staff need. No home printing, no photos of the list. Face down or covered at the desk; never left on the front desk or a table. At the end of the test day shred every copy and unused card (cross-cut shredder or locked shred bin, never the recycling bin) and write one log line: date, copies printed, copies shredded, initials. The counts must match. A missing list is a possible data breach: tell Grace the same day. Lounge staff use booking data only, never the clinical record.

deliverable.format: A printable checklist. Section A: Before you print (3 lines). Section B: a table of at most 8 rows (step, what to check, tick). Section C: On the morning, 4 lines. Section D: End of the test day, 4 lines, then the one-line log format. Section E: if something goes wrong, a table of at most 4 rows.
deliverable.write_only: the five sections and Questions for Anthony
deliverable.do_not_write: a health detail, a path, a due date or a referral on the list or cards, a printer model, a supplier

extra_checks: The 06:45 roster cutoff and the count-match step are both present.
The log line has date, copies printed, copies shredded and initials.
